questions.question: How much commission did we pay our agents last year?
questions.why: Missing measure: no table or column records commissions or any payment to agents. Agents appear only as a role code (AG) in agreement_party_role.

questions.question: How much have we recovered through subrogation on closed claims?
questions.why: Missing measure: claim amounts are only loss/expense payments and reserves (claim_amount with loss_payment, loss_reserve, expense_payment, expense_reserve). There is no recovery, salvage or subrogation amount.

questions.question: How much premium did we cede to reinsurers for hurricane exposure?
questions.why: Missing measure and entity: there is no reinsurance treaty, reinsurer or ceded amount anywhere in the schema; premium exists only as gross policy amounts.

questions.question: What is the total unpaid premium balance our policy holders still owe?
questions.why: Missing measure: there is no billing, invoice, receivable or payment-received data. Premium is recorded only as the amount charged per coverage period.

questions.question: What is the average credit score of our policy holders?
questions.why: Missing attribute: person and party have no credit score or any financial attribute of the customer.

questions.question: Which vehicle makes and models have the most claims?
questions.why: Missing attribute: insurable objects have no type, make, model or any vehicle details (insurable_object holds only an identifier, an empty type code and a location).

questions.question: What is the average square footage and roof type of the homes we insure?
questions.why: Missing attribute: no building characteristics (size, roof, construction) are stored for insured objects. The separate fire_claim sample has only year built, fireplace and fire-station distance.

questions.question: How many claims were denied as fraudulent?
questions.why: Missing attribute: claims have no denial, fraud or outcome flag; Claim_Status_Code is empty and there is no fraud investigation data.

questions.question: How many new claims were opened in 2023?
questions.why: Missing time period: claims in the data were opened only between January and June 2019; nothing is recorded for 2023.

questions.question: What was our total premium for coverage periods in 2012?
questions.why: Missing time period: coverage periods and premiums start on 2015-01-01 and end on 2020-05-31; there is no 2012 data.

questions.question: How did our total loss reserves change from quarter to quarter during 2019?
questions.why: Missing time grain: claim amounts carry no transaction or valuation date (Event_Date is empty) and there are no reserve snapshots, so reserve history over time does not exist.

questions.question: Which claims adjuster handled the most claims?
questions.why: Missing entity: the only party roles are policy holder (PH), agent (AG) and underwriter (UW); no adjuster or claim-handler is recorded, and claims have no party role table.

questions.question: Which brokerage agency or sales office wrote the most policies?
questions.why: Missing entity: agents are individual people; there is no agency, branch, sales office or distribution channel. The only organization is the insurer itself.

questions.question: Which product line (homeowners, auto, commercial property) has the highest loss ratio?
questions.why: Missing entity: there is no product or line-of-business table; agreement.Product_Identifier and coverage/coverage-part codes are empty.

questions.question: Which marketing campaign brought in the most new policy holders?
questions.why: Missing entity: there is no marketing, campaign, lead or acquisition-source data in the warehouse.
